mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID , USER_NM , ADMIN_YN , USER_STS , USE_YN , ROLE , PROFILE_IMG_URL FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PASSWORD = #{password} AND USER_STS != '99' AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT SRVC_CD , COALESCE(NULLIF(FN_GET_SRVC_NM(SRVC_CD), ''), '') AS SRVC_NM , WH_CD , COALESCE(NULLIF(FN_GET_WH_NM(SRVC_CD, WH_CD), ''), '') AS WH_NM , BASE_YN FROM TB_USER_AUTH WHERE 1 = 1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BASE_YN DESC, SRVC_CD, WH_CD
